Name: AuralisArcana's Stone Farmhouse
Author: AuralisArcana
Description:
A mod that replaces the default farmhouse with one made of stone and blue tiles.

The sprites vary by season, but this can be changed in settings. Additionally, this mod also supports colour zones, but those are currently broken (Content Patcher 1.6.9 will fix this problem).

Found any issues? Please post on this mod's page to let me know, so I can fix them ASAP.

Downloads.Description: Updated version of the original file that actually works in autumn and includes paint zones. Please note that paint zones are currently kind of broken, and don't properly work right now. Content Patcher's 1.6.9 update should fix that though.
